scope: Exact periodic-cover, arithmetic, fixed-cover trace and candidate-filter controls. Direct norm quotients verify the nonbox socle defect. Sector-wide surface budgets, thin-cover obstructions, socle-free dyadic shell bounds and their logarithmic obstruction are checked. Period-gap identities, common regional boxes and active-generator slab obstructions are independently checked by monic division and primal/dual bases. Four global price sectors and a uniform large-box obstruction at a positive arithmetic ray are checked. No unrestricted asymptotic separation, sharp nonbox refinement-fan count or novelty certificate.

period_gap_controls.scope: The regional count is a classical lattice-volume corollary using explicit period identities. The all-field active-generator obstruction defeats cube-only corank pruning, not the joint shell bound. No infinite prime constellation, full fan count, unrestricted improvement or novelty certificate is asserted.

global_gap_controls.scope: A classical common-box vertex bound now covers all positive weights, with O(n^(7/3)) for comparable periods with bounded normalized gaps, not a quadratic count or unrestricted improvement. The uniform box obstruction concerns the full group cover, not an asserted quotient basis or fan-count lower bound. Its infinitesimal perturbations lie at a single positive-ray degeneration; the already proved local linear refinement bound remains valid.
